responsibility: This implementation module is the core DynamicStrings-based numeric parsing and formatting engine for GNU Modula-2. It converts integers and cardinals across bases, parses and formats LONGREAL values via ldtoa/strtold with dtoa linkage support, builds results with DynamicStrings operations, performs rounding and carry propagation for significant-figure and decimal-place formatting, and reports internal invariant failures through M2RTS. It is the managed-string conversion layer used by modules such as FpuIO, FormatStrings, NumberIO, and gdbif when raw ARRAY OF CHAR conversions are insufficient.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation for the StringConvert pair: it realizes the conversions and decimal/significant-figure rounding logic, including DynamicStrings manipulation and ldtoa/strtold-backed floating-point handling, while StringConvert.def only declares that API.
